description: This Java class GaugesPanel manages the user interface for displaying and configuring gauges in an automotive ECU tuning application. It handles layout, user interactions, and component visibility related to sensor data visualization.

classes.name: GaugesPanel
classes.description: Main class providing the GUI for gauges layout, control, and configuration in the UI.

classes.name: GaugesPanel.DetachedRepository
classes.description: Singleton managing a collection of DetachedSensor instances within the GaugesPanel context.

methods.name: GaugesPanel
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the gauges UI, layout, and configuration persistence.

methods.name: createMiddleLeftPanel
methods.description: Creates the left part of the middle split panel, containing gauges and RPM display.

methods.name: createTopPanel
methods.description: Builds the top panel with control buttons and top right menu.

methods.name: createRightTopPanel
methods.description: Creates the right side of the top panel with size selector and menu buttons.

methods.name: createMenu
methods.description: Builds context menu for toggling RPM, messages, and log settings.

methods.name: prepareMessagesPanel
methods.description: Sets up the messages display panel.

methods.name: createLeftTopPanel
methods.description: Creates the left part of the top panel with pause and save buttons, RPM label, and command input.

methods.name: createPauseButton
methods.description: Creates a toggle button for pausing/resuming gauge data updates.

methods.name: createSaveImageButton
methods.description: Creates a button to save the current gauges view as an image.

methods.name: setSensorGridDimensions
methods.description: Adjusts the gauges grid layout and loads sensor elements.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves grid size properties into the configuration.

methods.name: applyShowFlags
methods.description: Updates visibility of RPM and message panels based on user settings.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main GUI component container.
